subject: general
question: Who among the following sportspersons is credited with the autobiography ‘Undisputed Truth’?
solution:
The correct answer is __Mike Tyson.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Tyson is considered to be one of the greatest heavyweight boxers of all time.
 
• The Autobiography of Mike Tyson is Undisputed Truth: My Autobiography.
 
• A bare-knuckled, tell-all memoir from Mike Tyson, the onetime heavyweight champion of the world—and a legend both in and out of the ring.
 
• Mike Tyson’s raw and unfiltered autobiography, “Undisputed Truth,” chronicles his tumultuous life—from his rise as a boxing prodigy to his fall from grace due to personal struggles, legal issues, and controversies.
 
• Co-written with Larry Sloman, the book provides an intimate look into Tyson’s triumphs and tribulations inside and outside the ring.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Muhammad Ali

 
 
• ​His autobiography, “The Greatest: My Own Story,” co-authored with Richard Durham, delves into his remarkable boxing career, his activism, and his larger-than-life persona.
 
• It’s a captivating read that reveals the man behind the iconic “float like a butterfly, sting like a bee” motto.
 
 
 
• Kevin Pietersen 
 
 
• ​ Kevin Pietersen’s autobiography is titled “KP: The Autobiography”.
 
• In “KP,” Pietersen shares his cricketing journey, controversies, and personal experiences.
 
• The book provides insights into his rise as an England cricketer, his clashes with cricketing authorities, and his eventual exit from international cricket.
 
 
 
• Matthew Hayden is an Australian cricketer known for his aggressive batting.
